rawContent: I find it sad that the statue of #JenReid was removed from the plinth at 5.30 this morning by workmen on behalf of Bristol council. Remember, by saying #BlackLivesMatter I’m not saying other lives don’t (you know that though, don’t you?)

@Anth0ny_Ward I find this more than a little sad. That said, the #BLM movement remains a powerful voice around the world.

And remember, when I say #BlackLivesMatter I’m not saying other lives don’t - but you know that, don’t you? 😊

@CliveGeorgeHil1 @jgraddon You’re absolutely right - i worked with councils for over 20 years, and I know they can be cumbersome beasts. I’d be delighted if this would contribute to a conversation where folk stopped calling each other names, or rejoicing in the discomfort of others. #BLM
